RoachMotelSpender.note: Demonstration drain target. Owner-gated; inert once its approval is revoked.

Permit2AllowanceView.note: Guard read for the Permit2 revoke. Flattens Permit2 allowance() (uint160,uint48,uint48) to one uint160, because check-and-execute's condition cannot select a tuple member. Ownerless, stateless, immutable, pure pass-through.

watchedWallet.note: Org Turnkey smart account. Both the watched wallet and the revoke sender, because approve(spender,0) clears msg.sender's allowance and KeeperHub signs only for this account.
